column1: It is hereby notified that the Annual Duruthu Maha Religious Festival and Procession of Pilana Purana Sri Maha Temple
in  the  Grama  Niladhari  Division  of  No.  152,  Pilana,  Divisional  Secretary’s  Division  of  Akmeemana,  District  of  Galle,
Southern Province, will be held from 04th of December 2025 to 3rd of January 2026 as per the regulations published in the
Extra Ordinary Gazette Notification No. 2146/18 dated 22.10.2019 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka in
terms of the Section 2 of the Pilgimages Ordinance (Cap.175).
